# Metric surface

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-metric-surface. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Run `make generate` after changing what a collector declares. -->

Every metric each collector can publish, with the labels that vary on it,
taken from the collectors' `Describe()` output.

This is the declared surface, not a scrape. A scrape shows only what the
cluster happened to have: with no reservations configured, a deleted
reservation metric and a reservation metric with nothing to report look
exactly alike. `Describe()` tells them apart, which is what makes this file
usable as a non-regression baseline.

A change here is a change operators can see. Renaming a metric, adding or
removing a label, or gating a metric behind a new flag all show up as a diff
on this file in the pull request that does it. A change that leaves it
untouched has moved nothing anyone scrapes.

Collectors whose surface depends on a cardinality flag appear once per
setting, so both halves of the knob are covered.

The Go runtime, process and build-info collectors are not listed: they come
from client_golang, this project does not name them, and a change there is
upstream's to announce.

## Exporter internals

What the exporter publishes about itself. Not behind a `--collector.<name>`
flag, and read by the health dashboard and the alerting rules rather than by
anyone asking about Slurm.

### collector status

```
slurm_exporter_collector_duration_seconds{collector}
slurm_exporter_collector_success{collector}
```

### command execution

```
slurm_exporter_command_duration_seconds{command}
```

### command errors

```
slurm_exporter_command_errors_total{command}
```

### cache age

```
slurm_exporter_cache_age_seconds{cache}
```
